messages:
james_support: Customer ACME reporting ~500 function invocation errors right after v14 rollout. Main error: schema_validation_failed for tool 'invoice_lookup'. Also intermittent 401s and billing complaints. Escalating to oncall.
maya_eng: Copy. Which precise model/version did they use?
james_support: redwood-v14.0.2 — rollout hit prod ~03:12 UTC last night. They say failures spiked immediately after canary->full. Sample from their logs: 
```json
{"tool":"invoice_lookup","args":{"session":"abc123","invoice_id":null},"error":"schema_validation_failed: missing required field 'user_id'"}
```
jonah_oncall: Looks like resolver routed to legacy implementation invoice_lookup_v1 which expects user_id. Router logs show selector matched alias 'invoice_lookup' -> v1 for some requests. Investigating selector rules.
eng-deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollout v14.0.2 -> production @ 2026-03-15T03:12:45Z
maya_eng: I can reproduce locally. When model returns tool name without explicit suffix we fall back to alias mapping. v14 seems to have changed tool naming semantics so it emits short names. Resolver didn't map to v2 variants.
sophia_prod: Also seeing a proxy latency spike and a few auth refresh failures at the same time window. Could be related if older tool uses different auth header expectations.
jonah_oncall: Proposed quick mitigation: update router mapping to prefer invoice_lookup_v2 for ACME org, add a specific override mapping. I'll push a 10% canary patch for router behavior.
james_support: Customer wants rollback if not fixed in 30m. They're on Dedicated and flagged for SLA escalation.
maya_eng: Repro steps I used:
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-v14","input":"lookup_invoice:123","functions":[{"name":"invoice_lookup_v2","schema":{...}}]}'
2) Observe response tool name returned by model: 
```json
{"tool":"invoice_lookup","args":{"session":"abc123"}}
```
jonah_oncall: Router patch applied to 10% traffic for ACME. Monitoring metrics now.
maya_eng: After patch, tool-mismatch error rate for ACME down ~80% on impacted hosts. Still seeing a small tail (~5%).
james_support: Customer sees fewer errors but still reports occasional failures. They reiterated rollback threat.
sophia_prod: Billing team flagged that schema_failed calls are still being counted as billable function invocations. Need to exclude them pending root cause.
aya_billing: Acknowledged. I'll open an invoice adjustment and pause automated charges for org-acme while we investigate. Ticket TG-4591.
jonah_oncall: Recommend no immediate full rollback. Keep router override + push a parser normalization in the output-processing layer to normalize tool names to preferred variants (append _v2 when ambiguity detected). If we get <1% failures in 1h, we can hold.
maya_eng: I'll prepare the normalization patch and a canary deploy. Should be low-risk.
james_support: I'll communicate plan and ETA to ACME, include temporary credits and SLA hold. Thanks all :thumbsup:
eng-monitor-bot: Alert resolved: org-acme tool-mismatch-errors - recovered at 03:46 UTC (secondary spike still being tracked).
